relations.subject: Hermann Friedrich Mögling
relations.evidence: At the age of 18 he started studies at seminary, then theology at Tübingen (met Gundert and Weigle there), but after five years, in 1834, went through a dramatic religious crisis

relations.subject: Hermann Friedrich Mögling
relations.evidence: in 1834, went through a dramatic religious crisis and moved to mission school of Basel.

relations.subject: Hermann Friedrich Mögling
relations.evidence: Together with Hebich he founded the Southern Mahratta Mission in Dharwar

relations.subject: Hermann Friedrich Mögling
relations.evidence: In 1838-52 he worked in Mangalore for Basel Mission as teacher and preacher.

relations.subject: Hermann Friedrich Mögling
relations.evidence: Married Pauline Franziska Bacmeister (1825–1861, the widow of his friend and cousin —> G. Weigle)
